settings.editor: A SCEGA conference licence is the authority's approval for the applicable conference category. The application route depends on the programme, organizing entity, venue and accompanying activities. A one-day format or an overseas speaker does not, by itself, settle that classification.

Start with the purpose of your conference and the people it brings together. We review the programme, session format and proposed participation to identify the questions that affect its application route.
